{{/* Vendor Layout Template - Stratus Design System Provides the sidebar + topbar layout structure for vendor pages. Required context: - .title: page title - .activePage: string for sidebar active state ("orgs" | "links") - .breadcrumbs: []map[string]interface{} for breadcrumb navigation - .user: user object - .theme: ThemeSettings object (for the settings panel) - Optional theme variables: .PrimaryColor, .SecondaryColor, .LogoBase64, etc. */}} {{.title}} {{/* Custom fonts via @font-face */}} {{if .HeadingFontBase64}} {{end}} {{if .BodyFontBase64}} {{end}} {{/* Additional Google Fonts for custom font names (if different from Inter) */}} {{if or (and .HeadingFont (not .HeadingFontBase64)) (and .BodyFont (not .BodyFontBase64))}} {{$needHeadingGoogle := and .HeadingFont (not .HeadingFontBase64)}} {{$needBodyGoogle := and .BodyFont (not .BodyFontBase64)}} {{if and $needHeadingGoogle $needBodyGoogle (ne .HeadingFont .BodyFont)}} {{else if $needHeadingGoogle}} {{else if $needBodyGoogle}} {{end}} {{end}} {{/* Vendor Theme Overrides - Layer on top of Stratus defaults */}} {{if or .PrimaryColor .SecondaryColor .HeadingFont .BodyFont .HeadingFontBase64 .BodyFontBase64}} {{end}}
{{/* Sidebar */}} {{template "vendor/partials/sidebar.html" .}} {{/* Main Content Area */}}
{{/* Topbar with Breadcrumbs */}} {{template "vendor/partials/topbar.html" .}} {{/* Entity Title Bar (shown on detail pages) */}} {{template "vendor/partials/title_bar.html" .}} {{/* Page Content */}}
{{/* Go templates don't support dynamic template names, so we use conditionals. Each page passes its unique contentTemplate name and we match it here. */}} {{if eq .contentTemplate "orgs_content"}} {{template "orgs_content" .}} {{else if eq .contentTemplate "org_detail_content"}} {{template "org_detail_content" .}} {{else if eq .contentTemplate "link_detail_content"}} {{template "link_detail_content" .}} {{else if eq .contentTemplate "theme_settings_content"}} {{template "theme_settings_content" .}} {{else if eq .contentTemplate "apps_content"}} {{template "apps_content" .}} {{else if eq .contentTemplate "app_health_checks_content"}} {{template "app_health_checks_content" .}} {{else}} {{block "content" .}}{{end}} {{end}}
{{/* Toast and Modal components (if needed by page) */}} {{template "vendor/partials/toast.html" .}} {{template "vendor/partials/confirm_modal.html" .}} {{template "vendor/partials/connect_org_modal.html" .}} {{template "vendor/partials/keyboard_shortcuts_modal.html" .}} {{/* Theme Settings Panel - lazy loaded via HTMX */}}
